question: Fiery Confluence (choose three, repeats allowed: 1 to each creature, 2 to each opponent, or destroy an artifact) in -- goblin and zombie tokens, Sol Ring, or 6 to each opponent -- and for what?

contributions.slice: MODE prescribe: three cards judged separately; verbatim, condensed
contributions.text:
The deck doctor on studies 025-027 (judged separately; NO CHANGE on all three; only try run).
Goldfish reads: Zndrsplt is listed `seen` but classify puts it under draw.unmodelled — the model reads a 1/4 body and nothing of the coin-flip draw (a coverage gap: a skipped draw reported as seen). Fiery Confluence: face_damage read as fixed 2, one mode only; the 6-to-each-opponent reach is not read. The study skeletons' goldfish rows compare branch with main list and are not about these cards.
025 Zndrsplt: NO CHANGE. About one won flip before the first loss (50% at least one, 25% at least two); Krang does not double Zndrsplt's own trigger (a flip, not a draw) but doubles what the draws cause (Shabraz, Shang-Chi, Pyromancer); a 5-mana 1/4 with no evasion for ~one card a turn at a turn-four table; Valeria already gives a card a turn for 4. Best cut if wanted: Brainstorm — killed by T6 -0.7 pts [-1.0, -0.5], damage @T10 -7.1 [-9.6, -4.6], extra cards by T8 -1.1 [-1.2, -1.0] (a floor; Zndrsplt's draws unread).
026 Fiery Confluence: NO CHANGE. The creature mode hits our board (one ping kills The Queen of Dale, Ragavan, Faerie Mastermind, Lizard Blades; two kill Inti, Conspiracy Theorist, Shang-Chi); Delayed Blast Fireball already does the token sweep one-sided. For Collective Defiance: killed by T6 -0.8 pts [-1.0, -0.6], extra cards by T8 -0.5 [-0.6, -0.4]; Prismari Command is DARK (no reading); Chaos Warp is one of the few Purphoros answers.
027 Violent Eruption: NO CHANGE (contested; the closest). Unread — argument only. For: 4 damage divided at instant speed against the A table's small creatures; madness {1}{R}{R} fires often; RRR fine (31 red lands, 36 red sources). Against: the only fair cut is Prismari Command (also unread), an instant one mana cheaper whose loot is two Brallin triggers, two Shabraz draws and a Treasure. A matchup call: Violent Eruption for Prismari Command is the one swap worth entertaining if the table is mostly pingers and goblins.
